claims.claim: The /shabbat endpoint returns `holiday` items, including EREV entries (Erev Yom Kippur, Erev Rosh Hashana), alongside candle-lighting and havdalah times when gy/gm/gd select a holiday week. Without gy/gm/gd it defaults to the upcoming weekend, which is why a weekday query in an ordinary week returns no holiday items. A two-day yom tov emits TWO candle-lighting items before a single havdalah.
